evidence: numerical-uncalibrated simulation (sim/js/concepts/activetether); NOT a physical test; parameters ASSUMED unless cited (design.js)

line.src: engineering line: 8-carrier UHMWPE 0.36 mm (PowerPro 50 lb class), EA 3308 N, 2.8 g / 25 m; fairlead shock spring 150 N/m (science_control H5) with a 0.12 m stroke (ASSUMED; bottoms at 18 N); slip clutch 35 N (engineering); weak link 38 N at the quiver exit (ASSUMED, below the 40 N body-force rule)

reel.src: engineering reel: T-Motor MN3110-17 700 Kv (92 mΩ, 21 A/180 s), 2:1 belt, 4 mm yo-yo drum r 15→21.9 mm for 25 m; 4S1P Molicel P28A cold bus 13.2 V − 0.144 Ω·I (fit to engineering operating points); regen clamped at 14.0 V by the 10 W shunt (cold cells not charged); rotor inertia 2.5e-5 kg·m² ASSUMED (reflected 0.21–0.46 kg, engineering)

ensemble.definition: shared simulateRun plan (38 s ride, 20 s rest, 33 s ride, final hold extended 10→25 s so the last dock completes) × FULLRUN_CASES_R4; round-4 rules: avail on footage().bodyPx ≥300 over col.riding (never flown = 0, launch/brake/tow/capture frames not delivered), artefact = overlap AND ≥2 px; jitter = p90 over flown cases of footageStability(R).subjectRms; headClear to helmetAt() incl. line and flyer outline, only the ≤3 s capture window excluded; setup = stop→locked + overrun + 20 s per manual stow; KE ground frame beyond 1.5 m; gates on windEstimate()

robustness.note: grid-only safety was shown to be non-robust in round 4; these runs repeat the wind grid on 6 seeds and add off-grid tail/cross winds

falseLaunch.note: synthetic traces from science_control/lib/traces.mjs (15 laps queue + chair/surface lift, walks, gondola, cat tracks, sit-downs, one bus descent per day); a "false launch" = detector start on a non-ski label (0) that also passes the apparent-wind gate assuming a 3 m/s headwind. Cat tracks (label 2, ambiguous) are excluded. Synthetic activity models — field logs required (≥50 ski days).
